last_outcome: M1-17 (iteration 29): the chart's pinch-to-zoom floor -- packages/flight-sim/src/project.ts gained maxZoomForMinVisibleKm(segments, viewport, paddingRatio, minVisibleKm), the greatest zoom factor before the viewport's whole visible geographic window (not just the route's own bounding box) would drop under minVisibleKm, computed from the same computeFit projectSegments/projectPoint already share (widened to also expose minLat). FlightScreen.tsx computes it once via useMemo (MIN_VISIBLE_KM = 25) and passes it to FlightMap as a new required maxZoom prop; FlightMap itself derives nothing, it only clamps a live gesture value against the number it is handed. FlightMap.tsx wires pinch (two-finger) and pan (one-finger) through one PanResponder -- react-native's own built-in touch-responder system, no new dependency, no ADR needed. Confirmed (not assumed) that a real multi-touch gesture is testable in this container's jest-expo/web + @testing-library/react stack: react-native-web implements the responder system on genuine touchstart/touchmove DOM events, so fireEvent.touchStart/touchMove with both touches and changedTouches arrays reproduces an actual pinch end to end, provable by reading the rendered <G>'s transform attribute. Self-review found two real correctness gaps beyond the listed acceptance criterion: a zoom already in effect was never re-clamped if maxZoom itself shrank between renders with no new gesture (fixed by deriving the displayed zoom as clamp(zoom, 1, maxZoom) fresh every render, regression-tested via rerender with a smaller maxZoom), and a pinch starting with both touches at the same point divided by a near-zero distance producing NaN/Infinity (fixed by re-basing the pinch's start distance instead of dividing below a 1px floor, regression-tested with a coincident-touch start). Also: switched to @pidge/flight-sim's existing clamp instead of a local reimplementation, and lazily initialized the PanResponder (a plain useRef(PanResponder.create(...)) still rebuilds it on every render, and FlightScreen re-renders FlightMap up to 60x/sec). pnpm run verify green: gate:roadmap ok, 26 done/6 pending; gate:tests floor raised 193 -> 205 (+12: 5 project.test.ts + 7 FlightMap.test.tsx).
